note: Exporter identity is confirmed by customs records, not by website claims: 144 shipment records, latest 2026-01-31, with named foreign buyers in Austria, Poland, Germany and France and B/L numbers. Revenue and export value: null — ImportKey free view shows shipment counts only, no values, and no financials were publicly retrievable. Domestic supply evidence: not established (see domestic_evidence); no trace of domestic deliveries was found in the sources read, but the registries needed to check GST turnover were blocked, so domestic_status is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found'.
